description: The center will focus on the intersection of 5G technology and artificial intelligence (AI) and will lay the groundwork for the launch of 6G technology.
body_lead: Keeping up the pace for opening new technology related opportunities in the state, the Uttar Pradesh government has announced to build India’s first Telecom Centre of Excellence in IIT Roorkee . According to the state government, the new centre will not just widen UP’s participation in technology and innovation but will also propel the telecommunications sector. The state government has announced to shell out as much as Rs 30 crore in establishing a research center at IIT Roorkee in Saharanpur .
